research_conclusion: VERIFIED NEGATIVE RESULT with two parts. (1) The cost-robustness question is NOT_IDENTIFIED: the predeclared grid was evaluated and independently reproduced, but the signal under test is a constant long position, so the grid measures the cost sensitivity of a ~3x/year-turnover static exposure (candidate medians essentially unchanged at k=0/1/2: MSFT lb5 [0.052, 0.072], META lb5 [0.073, 0.067, 0.042], TSLA +0.001) while the cost-matched null absorbs full turnover cost. (2) Verified defect: research/backtest/regime_stability.py::momentum_signals (and mean_reversion_signals) use mean log price over the window instead of a log return, so the emitted weight is +1 (resp. -1) at every bar; 27/30 cells are single-sign and the 3 NVDA cells flip only where the price level crosses $1. Consequence: the admitted momentum cell and the falsified reversal cell test constant long/short exposure, not short-horizon return autocorrelation.
